social_circle.name: Maria Gonzalez

demographics.occupation: Retired homemaker and former part-time clerical worker

background.how_they_met: They met as young Puerto Rican adults in Massachusetts through family and church circles, then married when Antonio was in his twenties.
background.why_close: They have been married over fifty years, raised three children together, share a Catholic Puerto Rican household, and rely on each other for health, finances, meals, appointments, and family routines.

interests: staying connected with children and grandchildren
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, practical texts with reminders, questions, and gentle corrections. She uses complete sentences, rarely uses slang, and may add a heart or prayer-hands emoji for family or health messages.

recent_text_topics: Reminders about doctor appointments, prescriptions, grocery lists, and whether Antonio checked his blood sugar.
Coordinating Sunday dinner, who is visiting, and what Puerto Rican dishes Antonio should cook.
Light teasing about Antonio losing track of time in the garage or rationalizing another tool purchase.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Maria is Antonio's wife of over fifty years and keeps the calendar because he forgets what day it is. Q11 says Maria handles more bills and appointments while Antonio does repairs, yard work, and cooking. Q47 says they attend Mass most Sundays together.

social_circle.name: Carmen Gonzalez

demographics.occupation: Administrative coordinator at a medical office
demographics.education: Some college and medical office certificate

background.how_they_met: Carmen is Antonio and Maria's youngest adult child.
background.why_close: She lives in the same city, stops by most often, checks on her parents, and balances work, parenting, and family support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Frequent practical texts, often quick and multitasking. She uses abbreviations, check-in questions, and occasional emojis, especially when talking about the kids or dinner plans.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether Antonio and Maria need groceries, rides, or help with heavier house tasks.
Coordinating Mateo's rides, school schedule, and possible overnight stays.
Talking about Carmen's work stress, the kids, and Antonio offering food, repairs, or gas money.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Carmen as Antonio's daughter in Taunton and says she stops by once or twice a week. Q35 says Carmen is closest when Antonio needs support. Q46 says Carmen seems most stressed because she balances work, kids, and checking on Antonio and Maria.

social_circle.name: Elena Gonzalez

background.how_they_met: Elena is Antonio and Maria's eldest adult child.
background.why_close: She visits when she can, helps Antonio interpret reliable health information, and shares his practical, family-centered values.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Clear, explanatory texts in full sentences. She sends links sparingly, summarizes health or public information plainly, and avoids dramatic language.

recent_text_topics: Explaining vaccine, Medicare, or health-care information from reliable sources.
Planning her next Sunday visit to Taunton and what food Antonio is making.
Discussing old family photos, names, and stories for Antonio's family memoir.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Elena as Antonio's daughter in Bridgewater and says she usually comes on Sundays when she can. Q42 says Elena is good at looking up reliable sources and explaining them without drama. Q108 says Antonio wants to finish a family memoir with photos, recipes, and stories.

social_circle.name: Miguel Gonzalez

demographics.education: High school diploma and trade certification

background.how_they_met: Miguel is Antonio and Maria's adult son.
background.why_close: They share a hands-on trade mentality, family duty, and practical problem-solving. Miguel is the child Antonio calls for heavier physical tasks now that Antonio avoids ladders and heavy appliances.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, functional texts with few emojis. He often sends photos of repairs, asks direct questions, and replies with short confirmations like 'I'll swing by Saturday.'

recent_text_topics: Whether Miguel can come by for a heavy repair or check something Antonio no longer wants to lift alone.
Talking through the older Toyota's brake and inspection repair.
Red Sox comments during close games and family plans for the next visit.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Miguel as Antonio's son in New Bedford. Q35 says Miguel will come quickly for heavier things. Q34 says Antonio avoids ladders unless one of his sons is there. Q56 mentions a recent car repair on the older Toyota.

social_circle.name: Joe Martins

demographics.education: High school diploma and electrical apprenticeship training

background.how_they_met: Joe and Antonio met while working at the manufacturing plant, where Joe was an electrician and Antonio was a maintenance mechanic.
background.why_close: They share decades of plant work, retirement routines, fishing, old coworker memories, and the blunt humor of men who solved machinery problems together.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short texts with jokes, weather comments, and fishing logistics. He may send blurry fish photos, use all caps for teasing, and rarely writes long emotional messages.

shared_activities: talking like old coworkers on break
checking in after old coworkers' illnesses or deaths
recent_text_topics: Planning fishing times, river conditions, bait, weather, and whether Antonio's knees are up for it.
Remembering Frank after his death and checking on other old coworkers.
Running jokes about who was better at fixing plant breakdowns and who owes coffee.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names Joe Martins as Antonio's closest current friend, an old plant electrician, and says they fish together. Q44 says Antonio called another old coworker after Frank died, showing old coworker friendships remain emotionally important. Q07 also mentions the Taunton River Anglers Association.
